attributes.name: call-to-action control shape and fill
attributes.definition: The shape and fill style of a utility/action button (e.g. header contact or back-to-top control).

values.definition: Fully rounded button with a solid fill color.
Fully rounded button with a border and no fill.
Different shape/style, or the control is absent.

attributes.name: utility control content
attributes.definition: What the utility/action button contains as its label.

values.definition: Label text accompanied by an arrow or icon.
Plain text or a contact detail with no icon.
No text label, only an icon.

attributes.name: utility control placement
attributes.definition: Where on the page the utility/action control sits.

values.definition: Placed in the top header or nav bar.
Placed near the bottom of the page or footer.
